panel.title: Operations Company
notes: Client Manager talks with the user while operations, PM, coding, research, review, monitor, scribe, and scheduler roles coordinate internally.
Tools and settings are shared with the runtime, while role policies control allowlists and denylists.

sidebar_items.label: MiMo Coding Company
sidebar_items.description: MiMo-first self-improving coding harness with QA swarms and toolsmith loops.

panel.title: MiMo Coding Company
notes: Client Manager keeps one user thread while PM, coding, QA, reviewer, toolsmith, and scheduler roles keep the loop moving.
If a useful tool or skill is missing, the harness should build the smallest viable one instead of stopping.
